parameters.notes: Approval PREPARES and WAITS. Never approves/rejects/closes. Human decision arrives via the approval webhook (Wait node). Absence/timeout/views are never approval. No LLM role by design. Canonical rules: tools/_lib/approval.js.

nodes.name: Wait for Human Decision
nodes.notes: HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP: execution pauses here until POST /webhook-waiting/buywise-approval-decision/<procurement_id> with {approval_id, procurement_id, decision, actor, decided_at}. No auto-resume counts as approval.
